_comment: Template. Copy it to config/search.json (ignored by git) and replace ALL the values: the places, jobs and company below are only examples. Details: README.md, 'Change the search'.

la_bonne_alternance._comment: romes: ROME 4.0 code -> your label (see README.md to find a code). departments: postal code prefixes kept for this circle, or null to keep all.

ats._comment: boards: company -> [ATS, board]. ATS: smartrecruiters, greenhouse, lever or ashby. job_title_patterns and zone_cities: regular expression parts, without case. zone_cities is used only when the API gives no postal code.

memory._comment: To detect reposts. department_groups: departments that count as one area. city_areas: name in a city text -> area, when the text has no department number.
